title: libdbi-drivers fails to build on armhf in stonking because a build-dependency can't be installed:
description:
libdbi-drivers fails to build on armhf in stonking because a build-dependency can't be installed:

```
default-mysql-server:armhf Depends mysql-server but none of the choices are installable
```

In Ubuntu, default-mysql-server points to mysql-server, which isn't built for armhf

The package doesn't actually need default-mysql-server or default-mysql-client. Their only user is debian/test_mysql.sh, which has been disabled since 0.9.0-11 (debian/rules only echoes "test_mysql.sh is NOT run"). The MySQL driver (libdbd-mysql) is built against default-libmysqlclient-dev, which stays in Build-Depends and is available on armhf. configure gets explicit include and lib directories, so it doesn't use mysql_config or any server binaries

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~nadzeya/+archive/ubuntu/libdbi-drivers/+packages
